# wedos_dns_records_exclusive (Resource)

Exclusive management of every record in a WEDOS DNS zone. Records not in record_sets are deleted. Apex NS records are ignored. Destroying the resource stops management and leaves the records in place. Do not combine with wedos_dns_record_set on the same zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Owns every record in the zone except the apex NS records. Record sets that
# are not listed here are deleted on apply.
resource "wedos_dns_records_exclusive" "example" {
  zone = "example.cz"

  record_sets = [
    { name = "", type = "ALIAS", ttl = 300, records = ["d111111abcdef8.cloudfront.net"] },
    { name = "", type = "MX", ttl = 3600, records = ["10 mx1.example.net"] },
    { name = "", type = "TXT", ttl = 3600, records = ["v=spf1 include:_spf.example.net -all"] },
    { name = "www", type = "CNAME", ttl = 300, records = ["d111111abcdef8.cloudfront.net"] },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `record_sets` (Attributes Set) Every record set of the zone. An empty set deletes all records except apex NS. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--record_sets))
- `zone` (String) Name of the zone whose records this resource owns.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--record_sets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `record_sets`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name relative to the zone; "" for the apex.
- `records` (Set of String) Record values in WEDOS rdata format, one element per value.
- `ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds, 300 to 172800, applied to every value.
- `type` (String) Record type.

Optional:

- `author_comment` (String) Comment stored on every value. ASCII letters, digits and spaces only.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import the whole zone before the first apply when it already has records.
terraform import wedos_dns_records_exclusive.example example.cz
```
